task.description: Validate the ISS-0091 fix design (WF-03 Step 2b) before BACKEND-DEV implementation begins: unify tests/integration/helpers.zig's legacy schema-local schema_migrations tracker with the canonical public.schema_migrations tracker used by src/db/migrations.zig::Migrations.runForSchema().
acceptance_criteria: Every acceptance criterion in ISS-0091 has a corresponding design element
No implementation code beyond illustrative Type E snippets
Public function signature changes (url param) are listed and consistent with real call sites
Classification as Type E is correct per templates/lego-catalog.md
Technical claims verified against real source (Pool requirement, migrations_dir absoluteness, GBL- skip guard, advisory-lock preservation)
Hidden dependents on the removed schema-local table are checked

result.summary: src/design/iss0091_harness_migration_tracker_unification.md validated against docs/issues/ISS-0091.json and the real source of tests/integration/helpers.zig, src/db/migrations.zig, src/db/pool.zig, and src/design/iss504_migration_tracking.md. All four ISS-0091 acceptance-criterion options are covered by named design sections. Type E classification is correct (cross-cutting test-infrastructure refactor). All independently-verified technical claims are accurate: Migrations.runForSchema() requires *Pool not *pg.Conn; build_options.migrations_dir and BPM_MIGRATIONS_DIR are always absolute (confirmed build.zig:11,13 and all setEnvironmentVariable call sites); Migrations.runForSchema() already skips GBL-prefixed files for non-public schemas (src/db/migrations.zig:203-207); the advisory-lock-then-fast-path-check logic is preserved as described. Public signature changes (url: []const u8 parameter) are consistent with actual call sites at tests/integration/helpers.zig:589,597. Error taxonomy and dependencies are both addressed. Two MINOR issues noted for BACKEND-DEV's attention during implementation (not rework-blocking): (1) the design's dependency audit for 'does removing the harness's local schema_migrations bootstrap break any other reader?' only reasoned about iss102_claim_test.zig's direct makePool() pattern, but missed that tests/integration/db_integration_test.zig (TC-DB-01-01, TC-DB-01-02), tests/integration/xc06_backwards_compatibility_test.zig (TC-XC-06-01), and tests/integration/adp12_default_tenant_regression_test.zig (TC-ADP-12-03) all query bare unqualified schema_migrations on harness.conn under a tenant_default,public search_path; tracing actual search_path sequencing confirms their assertions (COUNT>0, rows.len==1, EXISTS) will still hold once only public.schema_migrations remains, so this is not a functional break, but BACKEND-DEV must re-run these three files to confirm and should update their stale in-code comments describing single-schema row counts; (2) the code snippets use an unqualified 'pool_mod' identifier without showing its import -- trivially resolvable as bpm.pool per sibling test files' existing pattern, but should be made explicit.

issues.description: Design's checklist item 'other code paths relying on the schema-local table' only audited iss102_claim_test.zig; missed db_integration_test.zig (TC-DB-01-01/02), xc06_backwards_compatibility_test.zig (TC-XC-06-01), and adp12_default_tenant_regression_test.zig (TC-ADP-12-03), all of which query bare unqualified schema_migrations on harness.conn. Verified their assertions still pass post-fix (count/rows.len/EXISTS checks are shape-tolerant), so not a functional break, but BACKEND-DEV should re-run these three test files explicitly and refresh their now-stale single-schema-count comments.

Design's illustrative Zig snippets reference 'pool_mod.Pool.init(...)' without showing the import; sibling test files alias this as 'bpm.pool.Pool' (e.g. iss102_claim_test.zig, db_integration_test.zig). Trivially resolvable but should be made explicit in the design.

result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 3) to implement per design, addressing the two MINOR notes during implementation
